prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    def rot(g): return [r[::-1] for r in g[::-1]]
    def fliph(g): return [r[::-1] for r in g]
    def flipv(g): return g[::-1]

    R = rot(grid)
    mism = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] != R[i][j]]

    FH = fliph(grid); FV = flipv(grid)
    out = []
    for i in range(h):
